note: Every finding the diagnostics can report: its rank and the one sentence a non-technical person reads. {0}, {1} are filled in by the script with counts, dates or sizes only, never names.

os.unsupported.text: This version of Windows ({0}) stopped getting security updates on {1}; it needs the free update to a newer version.

os.ending-soon.text: This version of Windows ({0}) stops getting security updates on {1}; plan the free update before then.

os.win10-esu.text: Windows 10 no longer gets security updates unless the PC is enrolled in Extended Security Updates (free with a Microsoft account, until {0}); check Settings > Windows Update.

os.win11-capable.text: This PC looks able to run Windows 11 (TPM {0}, Secure Boot {1}); upgrading is free and keeps it safe after {2}.

os.win11-not-capable.text: This PC may not meet Windows 11's requirements (TPM {0}, Secure Boot {1}); keep it enrolled in Extended Security Updates and plan a replacement before {2}.

os.lifecycle-stale.text: deskside's Windows support dates were last checked on {0}; they may be out of date.

update.pending.text: {0} Windows updates are waiting to install.

update.failed.text: {0} Windows updates failed to install in the last 30 days.

update.stale.text: Windows hasn't installed an update since {0}; updates may be stuck.

update.reboot.text: The PC needs a restart to finish installing updates.

av.off.text: No antivirus is protecting this PC right now.

av.realtime-off.text: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection is turned off.

av.signatures-old.text: The antivirus definitions are {0} days old.

av.thirdparty.text: {0} other antivirus product(s) are installed beside or instead of Microsoft Defender.

fw.off.text: The Windows firewall is off for {0} network type(s).

smartscreen.off.text: SmartScreen, which warns before running unknown downloads, is turned off.

smartscreen.policy-off.text: A policy on this PC turns SmartScreen off, which home PCs normally don't have; it may have been set by unwanted software.

pua.off.text: Blocking of potentially unwanted apps (adware, junk bundles) is off.

crypt.off.text: The Windows drive isn't encrypted, so anyone with the laptop could read its files.

crypt.no-recovery.text: Drive encryption is on but no recovery key is set up; if Windows ever asks for it, the files would be lost.

crypt.check-key.text: The drive is encrypted. Make sure its recovery key is saved at aka.ms/myrecoverykey or printed somewhere safe.

disk.unhealthy.text: A drive reports it is failing ({0}); back up now and replace it.

disk.wear.text: A drive has used {0}% of its rated life.

disk.full.text: The Windows drive is nearly full ({0} GB free).

disk.low.text: The Windows drive is getting full ({0} GB free).

battery.worn.text: The battery holds {0}% of its original charge; a replacement would restore battery life.

battery.tired.text: The battery holds {0}% of its original charge.

perf.memory-high.text: Memory is {0}% used right now; the PC will feel slow.

perf.memory-small.text: The PC has {0} GB of memory; 8 GB or more would make it noticeably faster.

perf.cpu-high.text: The processor is {0}% busy while nothing should be running.

startup.many.text: {0} apps start with Windows, which slows down start-up.

tasks.thirdparty.text: {0} scheduled tasks come from apps rather than Windows.

events.crashes.text: Windows crashed or lost power unexpectedly {0} time(s) in the last 30 days.

events.app-crashes.text: Apps crashed {0} time(s) in the last 30 days.

events.critical.text: {0} critical errors were logged in the last 30 days.

backup.none.text: Nothing is backing up this PC's files; photos and documents would be lost if the drive failed.

backup.onedrive.text: OneDrive is backing up {0} of Desktop, Documents and Pictures.

backup.restorepoints-none.text: There are no restore points to roll back to after a bad update or app.

backup.restorepoints-old.text: The newest restore point is from {0}.

account.admin-daily.text: The account used every day is an administrator; a standard account blocks most malware from installing.

account.local.text: The account isn't linked to a Microsoft account, so its drive recovery key and OneDrive backup aren't available.

account.admins.text: {0} accounts on this PC are administrators.

apps.count.text: {0} desktop apps and {1} Store apps are installed.

apps.junk-recommended.text: {0} app(s) are junk or trialware that should be removed.

apps.junk-questionable.text: {0} app(s) may not be needed; they are on the removal list to decide.

updates.wau-missing.text: Nothing keeps the apps on this PC updated automatically.

updates.wau-failing.text: Automatic app updates last ran on {0} and did not succeed.

updates.wau-ok.text: Automatic app updates are set up and last ran on {0}.

run.not-elevated.text: This check ran without administrator rights, so some sections could not be read.

run.managed.text: This PC belongs to a work or school; deskside only reports and changes nothing.
